title: Volatile Aromatic Hydrocarbons (VAH)
workUp: Front and back sorbent sections placed in separate GC vials. 1 mL of CS2 was added to each vial. 150 µL of n-octane (1%) is also added to each vial. Each vial was then capped immediately. The vials were then shaken for at least 30 min.
additional: followed by drying tube tee (250 mg)
